verdict.rationale: The product lets users choose between a read-only 'subscribe' bundle (`npx skills update` to pull new versions) or copying skill files as plain, editable repo files that 'you own' and that update only when you choose — giving basic version control (via ordinary git) and an update/no-auto-change guarantee. However there is no explicit built-in review workflow or rollback/undo mechanism for automations themselves beyond relying on generic git and npx update commands. Missing for 10: dedicated diff/review UI for skill changes, explicit rollback/revert command, changelog or version history tooling, and any evidence of reviewing or reverting automation behavior rather than just file updates.
